passages.text: There is nothing from outside of the man, that going into him can defile him; but the things which proceed out of the man are those that defile the man.
passages.note: character comes from within, not outward things

passages.text: For what does it profit a man, to gain the whole world, and forfeit his life? For what will a man give in exchange for his life?
passages.note: ambition and success at the cost of the soul

passages.text: Jesus said to him, “If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.” Immediately the father of the child cried out with tears, “I believe. Help my unbelief!”
passages.note: wanting to hope while struggling with doubt

passages.text: If any man wants to be first, he shall be last of all, and servant of all.
